thread:
Alex Nguyen: Morning triage — quick pulse. Current queue: 59 open, 12 high-priority. Noticed a cluster of embedding failures from a handful of customers in eu-west. Any patterns?

Priya Shah: looking. I pulled 5 recent error logs — seems like rate-limit 429s from our dedicated pool, not model errors. Reassigning tickets 17892/17893 to me.

Marco Ruiz: @Priya can you paste one of the logs? I can check routing layer.

Priya Shah: pasted snippet: ```
2026-03-17T08:41:12Z ERROR client.go:234 request_id=abc123 status=429 message="quota exceeded" model=embed-large region=eu-west
```

Taylor (oncall): I see a spike in requests from one org (acct-1289) — they started a bulk re-embed job around 07:40. I'm throttling them for now. :thumbsup:

Alex Nguyen: good catch. Can we add a quick macro to standard reply for rate-limit escalations? Something that explains throttling + steps to request higher quota.

Jen Park: drafting macro: "rate-limit-explainer-v1" — short, apologetic, includes wait times and link to quota request form. Ping me if you want specific wording.

Marco Ruiz: also flagging an unrelated minor regression — webhooks have 200–300ms extra latency for dedicated-east. Not impacting correctness but might affect customer-side timeouts. Filed infra ticket INF-4021.

Priya Shah: updating macros list: currently have billing-refund, standard-ack, rate-limit-explainer-v1. Suggest we add a note in the macro: ask for request_id and last successful timestamp. That speeds investigation.

Alex Nguyen: yes please. Macro checklist: 1) short apology 2) what we observed 3) request_id + exact timestamps 4) link to support docs + quota form. Keep under 4 short paragraphs.

Taylor (oncall): I updated the throttling rule for acct-1289 to soft-limit. If issues persist I'll escalate to infra on-call.

SupportBot: Auto-scan: high-priority queue increased by 3 in last 30m. Top tags: billing (2), embedding-failure (6), latency (4).

Jen Park: I'll push draft macro in the snippets channel in 15. Can someone review before we put it live?

Alex Nguyen: Priya + Marco can do a quick review after Jen posts. Also status numbers for noon check: please update thread with any changes.

Priya Shah: updated — reduced 429 hits by throttling the offending job. High-priority now 10. Still watching.

Marco Ruiz: infra ticket INF-4021 has preliminary root-cause: kernel scheduling load on dedicated-east hosts, working on mitigation. ETA for mitigation patch ~2h.

Taylor (oncall): adding note to affected customers via rate-limit-explainer-v1 once Jen's copy is approved.

Alex Nguyen: thanks team. If nothing else, we'll recheck at 12:00 UTC. Rapid follow-ups in thread only. :eyes:
